blocks.text: CABARROGUIS, Quirino- Gloom enveloped the Quirino People’s Gymnasium on Thursday night as residents gathered there to take a final glimpse of the late Gov. Dakila Carlo “Dax” Cua, who died Tuesday in Manila. Cua’s casket arrived in a convoy of vehicles at Cabarroguis from the Cauayan Domestic Airport in Isabela and was met by a throng of people lining up the sidewalks. Earlier on Thursday, Vice Gov. Julius Caesar Vaquilar formally took his oath of office as Cua’s successor, although he had automatically assumed the post on Wednesday.
